Literal convex source feasible set. Nonempty follows from actual hp. Closedness not needed for this conditional local inequality; remains mandatory for source attainment parent.

Current regularizer, current hint, actual loss sequence through current index n. n counts prior losses; G uses range(n+1). Ambient real psi/hint are extensions of their source domains, only values on V used.
Original source losses exclude bottom globally; required for ordinary EReal sum.

Declared finite-value branch: every included loss below top on all V, jointly with hbot finite there. Stronger than Algorithm7.8 played-point domain requirement; full extended/infinite-comparator branches remain OPEN. Already printed common-domain requirement in Algorithm15.9.

Exact total current-inclusive objective curvature, no componentwise regularizer curvature assumption. Lambda0 valid for sharp inequality; positive lambda needed separately for division-based Young bound.

Actual Algorithm7.8 prediction rule at the explicit prior-prefix-plus-hint function. This is supplied actual algorithmic minimization, not a hidden minimum of G or affine tilt, not an attainment theorem.

Explicit source-generalizing interface: continuous-linear support of current loss-minus-hint restricted to V. Source global coordinate subgradient implies this local support after real-value and coordinate-functional transport. No all-point support or global support of G is assumed.
Any feasible comparison point; can later be next prediction or approved terminal ghost. No minimizer property at q required.
